name: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon
summary: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon is an isometric bunker building and management simulation with a 1980s civil-defense look and dark comedy. The player checks every survivor at the gate by hand with a thermometer, penlight, stethoscope and UV lamp, along with their papers and bag, then stamps them ADMIT, QUARANTINE or TURN AWAY; some of them hide an infection. Starting from a backyard shelter, the player digs down to a ten-level mega-bunker for up to 300 survivors, managing air, power, water, food, morale and sickness, sending scavenging teams out by radio and researching new equipment. Each night a different kind of monster tests a different part of the bunker: diggers come up through the floors, crawlers enter through the air ducts and screamers follow the noise of the generators. The game has a campaign told in chapters and a sandbox mode.
